spatialinversion.skill.spatial_link.desc: Create two connected spatial anchors. Projectiles and items passing through one emerge from the other.
spatialinversion.skill.vector_redirect.d: Open a temporary portal in front of you that redirects incoming projectiles in your current look direction.
Swap positions with a targeted entity. Both destinations must be safe.
Create a field around you that bends the trajectories of incoming projectiles.
Charge a spatial attack that emerges from an unexpected angle near your target. Press again to release early.
spatialinversion.skill.fold_step.desc: Create two linked portals and instantly travel between them.
spatialinversion.skill.spatial_cage.desc: Surround an area with four connected portals that redirect projectiles and hinder escape.
spatialinversion.skill.absolute_inversio: Ultimate ability: Create two massive spatial surfaces that reverse the spatial relationship between their locations.
